install_wall_s_note: measured on the requeued install job 364058 (8 CPUs, hopper-cpu) with every package already in the uv cache from the preempted first attempt; that attempt spent 363 s downloading 73 packages, so a cold-cache install is about 970 s
install_steps_note: install.sh is the whole procedure (uv venv + uv sync --frozen --extra fsdp + math-verify for the shared reward); no CUDA extension is compiled, all come as NovaSky prebuilt wheels pinned by hash in uv.lock
conflicts: math-verify's antlr4_13_2 extra (antlr4-python3-runtime 4.13.2) breaks omegaconf, which SkyRL imports everywhere; pinned antlr4-python3-runtime==4.9.3 and math-verify[antlr4_9_3]
first_step_s_note: not measured yet (W1-S run queued). Smoke references: GSM8K Qwen2.5-1.5B on 2 shared GPUs, job start to first optimizer step ~34 min (incl. 8.3 min eval slowed by dataloader worker spawns, since fixed); W1 Qwen3.5-2B on 8 GPUs reached trainer init 17 min after job start
